title: Runner Envelope
description: Envelope the pi-runner and muse-runner wrapper scripts emit with --json. The required keys appear on every exit path; wrappers may add diagnostic keys, so additionalProperties stays open. Runners that call their CLI directly return that CLI's own output instead.

runner.description: Requested runner identity: pi, muse, or a Pi seat label such as kimi or glm.

effective_runner.description: Runner that produced the output; always equals runner, because no wrapper falls back.

effective_model.description: Model observed in a native or provider receipt. Null when the wrapper has only a requested or configured model label.

requested_model.description: Model requested by the caller. This is intent, not evidence that the model served the run.

configured_model.description: Model forwarded to a CLI or configured for a runner when known. This is not a serving receipt.

model_receipt.description: Serving-model provenance. A route can claim verified model access only when status is verified.

primary_model_ids.description: Serving IDs from primary assistant events.

auxiliary_model_ids.description: Serving IDs from child assistant events.

model_matches_requested.description: Exact serving ID comparison; null for aliases or missing or ambiguous evidence.

model_usage.description: Native per-model usage, already included in the terminal total cost.

auxiliary_model_usage.description: Usage labels outside the observed primary ID set, not serving proof or extra cost.

effective_provider.description: Provider or model author backing the run, such as moonshotai or meta.

model_author.description: Model publisher inferred from the selected model id. This is not the inference host.

gateway.description: Configured request gateway, such as openrouter.

inference_provider.description: Inference host identified by upstream evidence. Null when not observed.

provider_policy_receipt.description: Policy applied at the adapter request boundary. This does not identify an upstream inference host or attest account settings.

auth_ok.description: True on a successful run; false only when an authentication failure was detected; null when auth was never exercised, including a missing CLI.

fallback_reason.description: Always null: wrappers never fall back (runner-common.md, Seat fidelity). Kept for envelope compatibility.

success.description: Whether the run completed with return_code 0 and no native error.

print_invocation_started.description: False when the wrapper failed before launching the CLI; absence means unknown.

return_code.description: 0 success; -1 timeout; -2 CLI not found (seat_unavailable); -3 invalid input, native error, model mismatch, or blocked trust check.

stdout.description: Raw CLI stdout (native stream-json, json, or text). For debugging; prefer agent_message.

stderr.description: CLI stderr plus any native error text appended by the wrapper.

command.description: Shell-quoted command line that was executed.

working_dir.description: Working directory the CLI ran in.

role.description: Role overlay applied (planner, codereviewer, implementer, synthesizer, adversarial, challenger, researcher), or null.

restrict_tools.description: Whether a read-only analysis overlay/sandbox was applied.

agent_message.description: Clean final answer: trimmed result text for plain runs, or JSON-serialized output for --output-schema (structured_output) runs. Orchestrators should read this instead of parsing stdout.

session_id.description: Session id reported by the native CLI, when available.

status.description: Outcome label. Pi sets it on failure; Muse sets it on every run.

fallback_from.description: Always absent or null: wrappers never fall back. Kept for envelope compatibility.

output_json_valid.description: When an output contract is requested, whether the final answer parsed as exactly one JSON value before schema validation.

schema_valid.description: When --output-schema is supplied, whether the final JSON value passed the requested local output contract. A false value means the response must not count as a workflow vote.

output_contract_error.description: Human-readable reason a requested output contract failed (missing output, invalid JSON, or schema mismatch).

finish_reason.description: Stream-backed runners (pi): the native stopReason (stop, error, ...) from the terminal message event.

native_model_id.description: Stream-backed runners (pi): the model that actually answered, read back from the native stream.

native_provider.description: Stream-backed runners (pi): the provider that actually answered, read back from the native stream.

native_return_code.description: Stream-backed runners (pi): the raw process exit code before return-code normalization.

thinking.description: Stream-backed runners (pi): the reasoning-effort level forwarded to the CLI, when set.

prompt_file.description: Present when exactly one --prompt-file was supplied.

prompt_files.description: Present when more than one --prompt-file was supplied.

provider.description: Pi: request gateway or provider selected for the call, such as openrouter.

adapter_input_measurement.description: Byte size and digest of the prompt text the wrapper rendered; token_count stays null.

model_forwarded.description: Muse: whether the requested model was passed to the CLI.
